gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_1
gatekeeper_rules.title: Named Big Pharma Suitor + Specific Leaked Dollar Bid (75.0% Base Rate)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Tier-1 scoop must identify BOTH a specific Big Pharma suitor AND a concrete dollar valuation anchor (e.g., $124/sh AstraZeneca on $RYTM, $68.50 Pfizer on $GBT, $28B Amgen on $HZNP). Eliminates generic 'exploring options' rumors ($BMRN -20%, $ALNY -15%, $VKTX -45%).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Vague 'exploring options / activist sale' chatter with no leaked dollar bid ($BMRN, $ALNY, $FOLD, $ACAD, $VKTX).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_2
gatekeeper_rules.title: Commercial Rare-Disease Anchor + Standalone Fundamental Floor ('Walk-Away Cushion')
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target must have an FDA-approved commercial rare-disease/specialty drug + non-dilutive cash runway so a walk-away is cushioned at -16% to -21% ($89–$95 on $RYTM via $92.13M Q3 Imcivree +79.6% YoY & $750M KKR/Blackstone facility) rather than a -50% clinical wipeout.
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Unapproved binary clinical risk with no commercial floor ($CYTK -16.69%, $MLTX -11.64%, $BBIO -12.24%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_3
gatekeeper_rules.title: Clean Cap Table & Unencumbered Global Commercial Rights
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target must own unencumbered worldwide rights (or have bought down royalty/partner encumbrances, like $RYTM buying down LG Chem's bivamelagon royalty to 1%).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Entangled regional/partner co-development rights that block rival bidders ($PTGX / J&J-Takeda -5.27%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_4
gatekeeper_rules.title: Rejected Opening Bid / 2-Bidder Sweetening Tension ($124 -> $134/sh + CVR)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target board has rejected an opening bid or attracted a 2nd suitor into the data room ($GBT, $HZNP, $SGEN, $SAGE, $RNA, $MTSR, $CDTX, $AVDL, and $RYTM w/ AZN + 2nd bidder).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Chasing a solo-bidder spike above the deal price ($SWTX Feb 2025 $54 -> $47 = -12.96%; $MRTX $60.20 -> $58 = -3.65%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_5
gatekeeper_rules.title: Hard Valuation Anchor Ceiling: entry_pct_of_anchor <= 0.92 ($114.08 Max on $RYTM)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Entry price MUST NOT exceed 92.0% of the leaked valuation anchor (entry_pct_of_anchor <= 0.92). Your $100k lot at $113.00 = 91.1% of $124.00 floor (PASS). Do NOT add above $114.08.
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Overpaying > 92% of anchor ($VTYX $17.02 chase into $14.00 buyout = -17.74%; $MRTX $60.20 = 100.3%; $SWTX $54.00 = 108.0%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_6
gatekeeper_rules.title: $100k Tactical Lot (<0.5% NW Risk) & 7–20 Trading Day Schedule 14D-9 Clock
gatekeeper_rules.description: Hold $100,000 at $113.00 (~885 sh) in 0%-tax IRA: +$9,735 at $124 base (35% prob), +$18,585 at $134 sweetened (40% prob), vs. -$18,585 max loss at $92 walk-away floor (25% prob = -0.46% of $4M net worth). Hard time-stop: Dec 7 / Dec 14 (20–25 trading days).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Oversizing > $200k or holding past 25 trading days with zero follow-up headlines.
